annotations.text:
This is what shipped, not a proposal.

The palette is now FixedShot's Zapier theme, taken value for value from its DesignTokens: #FF4F00 on #FFFEFB, coffee ink, radii 12/12/6. The two tools read as one family — same accent, same ink swatches in the editor, sibling icons.

Three changes to the header row: the wordmark is title case and tight rather than tracked-out caps; the button carries the accent instead of a softer amber; and the shortcut is pinned to the button's right edge rather than sitting in the flex run, so it cannot crowd the label when the label changes length between languages.

The earlier camera silhouette was a filled shape in a different idiom from FixedShot's stroked brackets. Sharing the drawing language — accent tile, cream strokes only, round caps, 24% corner radius — is what makes the two icons look like they come from the same place, more than sharing the colour does.
